title: Twista - Overnight Celebrity (Remix)
description: Official remix to Twista's hit single, featuring a partially new verse from Twista (some bars were 1-1 reused), the hook done by Twista himself (so no Kanye vocals), and verses from Chicago rapper Bump J and Harlem rapper Cam'ron. Miri-Ben Airi's feature credit was also removed. Not on Twista's album that released that year ('Kamikaze'), but on UK CD2 of Twista's single 'Sunshine' and on the US single CD for 'So Sexy / Overnight Celebrity (Remix)' (which also includes the Remix Instrumental and an edited version of the Remix).
